tagline: Learn Claude thoroughly. Then build with it.
description: The Fable Club is an independent, student-run community at VIT Chennai for learning to build with Claude and agentic AI tools, open to all students.
why: VIT has plenty of AI users but no structured path to actually build with LLMs. The club gives students hands-on sessions and real projects, so they leave with something shipped, not just something attended.
highlights: Free, and open to every department
disclaimer: An independent student club. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.

recruitment.taskPrompt: Think of one small, boring task from your week, like notes, timetables, assignments or club work. How could an AI assistant like Claude help you with it?

timeline.title: Applications
timeline.detail: Fill in the form, including one short task. No code needed.

timeline.title: Online interviews
timeline.detail: A short online chat with the core board.
